name: Kitsune Kitchen
source:
A young man prepares for his parents return from Uncle’s Mansion, in the sunny state of Florida, when suddenly an internal conflict strikes. Becoming lost in a deep hunger for companionship, his stomach cries out for something to fill that emotional gap. Will the kitchen have the answers he is looking for? Perhaps. Will his passion escalate things far beyond reason? Absolutely.

Play through the story of a young man’s quest to create the ultimate BLT sandwich. Maybe even try to find love along the way? If not that’s cool too. It’s up to you to decide how you make the magic happen in Kitsune Kitchen, a hyperbolic visual-novel and an experience that you won’t soon forget.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/862920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻男子为父母从佛罗里达州的叔叔宅邸回来做准备，突然遭遇了内心冲突。由于极度渴望陪伴，他陷入深深的饥饿感，胃部呼唤着能填补情感空缺的东西。厨房会给他想要的答案吗？也许吧。他的热情会将事态推向远超理性的地步吗？当然会。

跟随一名年轻男子制作终极BLT三明治的旅程。也许还能在路上找到爱情？如果没有，也没关系。如何在《狐狸厨房》这部夸张的视觉小说中创造奇迹，由你决定；这段经历会让你久久难忘。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/862920/]Steam[/url]）
